list.subject: CEAI
list.title: AI FOUNDATIONS
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Artificial Intelligence (AI) is expected to continue to permeate various industries in years to come. In fact, according to a 2020 PWC study, 86 per cent of companies surveyed said that AI will become a “mainstream technology” at their organization by 2021.From the narrow AI applications embedded in your phone to Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), you will learn to distinguish the subtleties of AI systems. Additionally, you will be able to characterize the types of existing models behind the applications, and analyze the human, data, and technological resources necessary to develop such systems. Last, but certainly not least, this course teaches you the limitations and ethical issues, including biases, that can exist in AI applications and how to detect them.  Throughout your studies, you will have an opportunity to see AI in action through use cases that showcase the adoption of AI in several industries. Your challenge will be to explore how you can use AI to help solve problems in your everyday life and in your organization through case studies and other projects. This will help you better understand AI and evaluate the impacts of AI on your daily life. In this course, you won't just learn the basics of AI but actively participate in learning all the different facets that make up AI.This is an online, synchronous course.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Examine AI use cases in different contexts•	Identify AI readiness•	Examine the possibilities and limitations of AI•	Determine the requirements and criteria for a successful AI project•	Describe the pitfalls of AI*APP*This fully online course employs a project-based approach that focuses on the acquisition of practical real-world skills in AI. You will learn directly from industry professionals and receive individualized feedback. You will have the opportunity to go beyond AI theory by actively participating in assignments aimed at using AI for problem-solving.*WHO*•	Leaders with financial, operational, or technological responsibilities who are interested in adopting AI•	Managers who want to better support their technical AI employees or who may be involved in AI projects•	Employees in different industries who want to learn how AI solutions can help solve problems or want to contribute to their organization’s AI initiatives more meaningfully•	Students who want to prepare themselves for an AI workforce or explore AI as a potential career path•	Anyone who wants to learn the fundamentals of AI

list.subject: CEAI
list.title: RESPONSIBLE AI
list.description: *VID**KEYB*As AI systems continue to become more prevalent in daily life, it’s crucial to also understand the negative effects AI can have on society in the form of unfair outcomes, privacy intrusions, and more. Therefore, it’s imperative that you understand how to deploy AI systems that are ethical, safe and inclusive. This course will teach you how to identify ethical issues in AI systems, create and execute roadmaps, and engage with relevant multidisciplinary stakeholders to address those issues. Our action-oriented approach is designed to offer you practical advice and the confidence to implement ethical and responsible changes to your AI systems.To help develop your skills in responsible AI, this course references publicly discussed cases involving unethical behaviour. It also touches on AI systems you likely interact with every day where ethical issues exist. In addition to learning the basics of responsible AI, this course will help you become a more informed citizen in an AI-driven world by working on real deliverables.This is an online, synchronous course.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Identify potential ethical issues that might arise in the design, development, and deployment of AI systems•	Create roadmaps to minimize negative societal impacts and maximize humane outcomes from AI systems•	Assemble the most relevant internal and external stakeholders to address potential ethical issues•	Engage a team of multidisciplinary domain experts to gather feedback on ethical issues •	Execute ethical issues addressal roadmap while meeting business and functional requirements of the project*APP*This fully online course employs a project-based approach that focuses on the acquisition of practical real-world skills in AI. You will learn directly from industry professionals and receive individualized feedback. You will have the opportunity to go beyond AI theory by actively participating in assignments aimed at using AI for problem-solving.*WHO*•	Tech enthusiasts who want to add AI to their skillset•	Venture capitalists or investors looking to understand ethical issues in AI before investing in AI technologies•	Leaders with financial, operational, or technological responsibilities who are interested in adopting AI•	Managers who want to better support their technical AI employees or who may be involved in AI projects•	Employees in different industries who want to learn how AI solutions can help solve problems or want to contribute to their organization’s AI initiatives more meaningfully•	Students who want to prepare themselves for an AI workforce or explore AI as a potential career path•	Anyone working for the government who participates in policy decisions that may be affected by or related to data and AI•	Anyone who wants to learn the fundamentals of AI or is responsible for selecting and procuring AI systems

list.subject: CEAI
list.title: UNDERSTANDING AI DATA
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Artificial Intelligence (AI) doesn’t exist without data. In 2006, British mathematician Clive Humby said, “Data is the new oil.” And data is the fuel that powers AI. However, having data is not enough, you need good data. But how can you identify quality data in the AI world? This course provides the answer. The first part of the course will help you identify good data, spot potential biases, and interpret graphs and other visualizations from data. The second part of the course will focus on the practical aspects of data for AI projects. This section will help you assess data requirements for AI projects, differentiate between various storage methods, and identify data sources. Upon completion of the course, you will grasp the single most important aspect of AI—data.To help you develop data skills for AI, you will be exposed to case studies and other projects that resemble data-related situations AI professionals face daily. During these exercises, you will examine the different steps of the data lifecycle to help you assess data quality and the requirements for various AI projects. The assignments will position you as the domain expert and client on an AI project and teach you how to work alongside a data scientist. Are you up for the challenge? This is an online, synchronous course.We recommend taking the AI Foundations (CEAI 1001) and Responsible AI (CEAI 1002) before taking this course.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Explain the importance of "good" data in AI projects•	Describe the different types of data used in AI projects•	Identify the different techniques used to handle and store data in AI•	Assess what is required to carry out an AI project*APP*This fully online course employs a project-based approach that focuses on the acquisition of practical real-world skills in AI. You will learn directly from industry professionals and receive individualized feedback. You will have the opportunity to go beyond AI theory by actively participating in assignments aimed at using AI for problem-solving.*WHO*•	Tech enthusiasts who want to add AI to their skill set•	Leaders with financial, operational, or technological responsibilities who are interested in adopting AI•	Managers who want to better support their technical AI employees or who may be involved in AI projects•	Employees in different industries who want to learn how AI solutions can help solve problems or want to contribute to their organization’s AI initiatives more meaningfully•	Students who want to prepare themselves for an AI workforce or explore AI as a potential career path•	Anyone who wants to learn the fundamentals of AI

list.subject: CEAI
list.title: WORKING WITH AI
list.description: *VID**KEYB*What does the day-to-day of an AI professional look like? In this course, you will experience the typical AI workflow by participating in an AI project. From the problem definition stage to model training and evaluation, you will wear the hat of a data scientist and develop an end-to-end machine learning project using a user-friendly no-code software. This process will help you understand the risks and limitations of AI models and teach you how to mitigate them. Finally, you will learn about state-of-the-art AI applications and how they are used in the industry.This course focuses on experiential learning. You will explore how to use a no-code software, train a model, improve training data through feature engineering, and test the performance of your model. This is an online, synchronous course.We recommend taking the AI Foundations (CEAI 1001) and Responsible AI (CEAI 1002) before taking this course.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Manipulate data for an AI project •	Communicate with data in an easy-to-understand visual format•	Manage a simple end-to-end AI project using a no-code software•	Explore emerging techniques in machine learning and AI*APP*This fully online course employs a project-based approach that focuses on the acquisition of practical real-world skills in AI. You will learn directly from industry professionals and receive individualized feedback. You will have the opportunity to go beyond AI theory by actively participating in assignments aimed at using AI for problem-solving.*WHO*•	Tech enthusiasts who want to add AI to their skillset •	Managers who want to better support their technical AI employees or who may be involved in AI projects•	Employees in different industries who want to learn how AI solutions can help solve problems or want to contribute to their organization’s AI projects more meaningfully•	Students who want to prepare themselves for an AI workforce or explore AI as a potential career path•	Anyone who wants to begin experimenting with AI

list.subject: CEAI
list.title: FONDEMENTS DE L'IA
list.description: *VID**KEYB*L'intelligence artificielle (IA) continuera à se diffuser dans divers secteurs au cours des années à venir. En fait, selon une étude réalisée par PwC en 2020, 86 % des entreprises interrogées ont déclaré que l'IA deviendrait une « technologie courante » au sein de leur organisation. Qu'il s'agisse d’applications mobiles ou de l'intelligence artificielle générale (IAG), vous apprendrez à distinguer les subtilités des systèmes d'IA. En outre, vous serez en mesure de caractériser les types de modèles existants derrière les applications et d'analyser les ressources humaines, les données et les technologies nécessaires pour développer de tels systèmes. Ce cours vous enseigne les limites et les problèmes éthiques, y compris les biais, qui peuvent exister dans les applications d'IA et comment les détecter. Tout au long de vos études, vous aurez l'occasion de voir l'IA en action grâce à des cas d'utilisation qui illustrent l'adoption de l'IA dans plusieurs industries. Votre défi sera d'explorer comment vous pouvez utiliser l'IA pour aider à résoudre des problèmes dans votre vie quotidienne et dans votre organisation à travers des études de cas et d'autres projets. Cela vous aidera à mieux comprendre l'IA et à évaluer son impact sur votre vie quotidienne. Dans ce cours, vous n'apprendrez pas seulement les bases de l'IA, mais vous participerez activement à l'apprentissage de toutes les différentes facettes qui composent l'IA. Il s'agit d'un cours en ligne, synchrone.*CNT*Ce cours est un excellent moyen de vous aider à : •	Examiner les cas d'utilisation de l'IA dans différents contextes•	Identifier l'état de préparation à l'IA •	Examiner les possibilités et les limites de l'IA •	Déterminer les exigences et les critères d'un projet d'IA réussi •	Décrire les pièges de l'IA *APP*Ce cours entièrement en ligne utilise une approche par projets qui se concentre sur l'acquisition de compétences pratiques dans le monde réel en matière d'IA. Vous apprendrez directement auprès de professionnels de l'industrie et recevrez un retour d'information individualisé. Vous aurez l'occasion d'aller au-delà de la théorie de l'IA en participant activement à des missions visant à utiliser l'IA pour résoudre des problèmes.*WHO*•	Les passionnés de technologie qui souhaitent ajouter l'IA à leur ensemble de compétences. •	Les dirigeants exerçant des responsabilités financières, opérationnelles ou technologiques et qui souhaitent adopter l'IA. •	Les gestionnaires qui souhaitent mieux soutenir leurs employés techniques en matière d'IA ou qui peuvent être impliqués dans des projets d'IA. •	Les employés de différents secteurs qui veulent apprendre comment les solutions d'IA peuvent aider à résoudre des problèmes ou qui veulent contribuer de manière plus significative aux initiatives d'IA de leur organisation.•	Les étudiants qui souhaitent se préparer à travailler dans le domaine de l'IA ou explorer l'IA en tant que carrière potentielle. •	Toute personne souhaitant apprendre les principes fondamentaux de l'IA.

list.subject: CEAI
list.title: L’IA RESPONSABLE
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Alors que les systèmes d'IA continuent à se répandre dans la vie quotidienne, il est essentiel de comprendre les effets négatifs que l'IA peut avoir sur la société, sous la forme de décisions biaisées, d'intrusions dans la vie privée et bien plus encore. Il est donc impératif que vous compreniez comment déployer des systèmes d'IA qui soient éthiques, sûrs et inclusifs.  Ce cours vous apprendra à identifier les questions éthiques dans les systèmes d'IA, à créer et à exécuter des feuilles de route, et à vous engager avec des partenaires multidisciplinaires pertinents pour aborder ces questions. Notre approche orientée vers l'action est conçue pour vous offrir des conseils pratiques et la confiance nécessaire pour mettre en œuvre des changements éthiques et responsables dans vos systèmes d'IA. Pour vous aider à développer vos compétences en matière d'IA responsable, ce cours fait référence à des cas discutés publiquement impliquant des comportements contraires à l'éthique. Il aborde également les systèmes d'IA avec lesquels vous interagissez probablement tous les jours et qui posent des problèmes éthiques. En plus d'apprendre les bases de l'IA responsable, ce cours vous aidera à devenir un citoyen plus informé dans un monde piloté par l'IA en travaillant sur des livrables réels. Il s'agit d'un cours en ligne, synchrone.*CNT*Ce cours est un excellent moyen de vous aider à : •	Identifier les problèmes éthiques potentiels qui pourraient survenir lors de la conception, du développement et du déploiement des systèmes d'IA •	Créer des feuilles de route pour minimiser les impacts sociétaux négatifs et maximiser les résultats des systèmes d'IA •	Rassembler les partenaires internes et externes les plus pertinents pour aborder les questions éthiques potentielles  •	Engager une équipe d'experts pluridisciplinaires pour recueillir des informations sur les questions éthiques•	Exécuter la feuille de route relative aux questions éthiques tout en respectant les exigences commerciales et fonctionnelles du projet*APP*Ce cours entièrement en ligne utilise une approche par projets qui se concentre sur l'acquisition de compétences pratiques dans le monde réel en matière d'IA. Vous apprendrez directement auprès de professionnels de l'industrie et recevrez un retour d'information individualisé. Vous aurez l'occasion d'aller au-delà de la théorie de l'IA en participant activement à des missions visant à utiliser l'IA pour résoudre des problèmes.*WHO*•	Les passionnés de technologie qui souhaitent ajouter l'IA à leur palette de compétences•	Les investisseurs en capital-risque qui souhaitent comprendre les questions éthiques liées à l'IA avant d'investir dans des technologies d'IA•	Les dirigeants ayant des responsabilités financières, opérationnelles ou technologiques qui sont intéressés par l'adoption de l'IA •	Les gestionnaires qui souhaitent mieux soutenir leurs employés techniques en matière d'IA ou qui peuvent être impliqués dans des projets d'IA •	Les employés de différents secteurs qui veulent apprendre comment les solutions d'IA peuvent aider à résoudre des problèmes ou qui veulent contribuer de manière plus significative aux initiatives d'IA de leur organisation. •	Les étudiants qui souhaitent se préparer à travailler dans le domaine de l'IA ou explorer l'IA en tant que carrière potentielle •	Toute personne travaillant pour le gouvernement et participant à des décisions politiques pouvant être affectées par ou liées aux données et à l'IA•	Toute personne qui souhaite apprendre les principes fondamentaux de l'IA ou qui est responsable de la sélection et de l'acquisition de systèmes d'IA

list.subject: CEAI
list.title: COMPRENDRE LES DONNÉES DE L’IA
list.description: *VID**KEYB*En 2006, le mathématicien britannique Clive Humby déclarait : « Les données sont le nouveau pétrole ». Et les données sont le carburant qui alimente l'IA. Cependant, il ne suffit pas d'avoir des données, il faut des données de qualité. Mais comment identifier des données de qualité dans le monde de l'IA ? Ce cours apporte la réponse.  La première partie du cours vous aidera à identifier les bonnes données, à repérer les biais potentiels et à interpréter les graphiques et autres visualisations à partir des données. La deuxième partie du cours se concentre sur les aspects pratiques des données pour les projets d'IA. Cette section vous aidera à évaluer les besoins en données pour les projets d'IA, à différencier les diverses méthodes de stockage et à identifier les sources de données. À l'issue de ce cours, vous aurez compris l'aspect le plus important de l'IA : les données. Pour vous aider à développer des compétences en matière de données pour l'IA, vous ferez face à des études de cas et à d'autres projets qui ressemblent à des situations liées aux données auxquelles les professionnels de l'IA sont confrontés quotidiennement. Au cours de ces exercices, vous examinerez les différentes étapes du cycle de vie des données pour vous aider à évaluer la qualité des données et les exigences de divers projets d'IA. Les missions vous positionneront en tant qu'expert du domaine et client d'un projet d'IA et vous apprendront à travailler aux côtés d'un scientifique des données. Êtes-vous prêt à relever le défi ? Il s'agit d'un cours en ligne, synchrone. Nous recommandons de suivre les cours Fondements de l'IA (CEAI 1001F) et L’IA responsable (CEAI 1002F) avant de suivre ce cours. *CNT*Ce cours est un excellent moyen de vous aider à : •	Expliquer l'importance de « bonnes » données dans les projets d'IA  •	Décrire les différents types de données utilisés dans les projets d'IA •	Identifier les différentes techniques utilisées pour traiter et stocker les données dans l'IA  •	Évaluer ce qui est nécessaire pour mener à bien un projet d'IA*APP*Ce cours entièrement en ligne utilise une approche par projets qui se concentre sur l'acquisition de compétences pratiques dans le monde réel en matière d'IA. Vous apprendrez directement auprès de professionnels de l'industrie et recevrez un retour d'information individualisé. Vous aurez l'occasion d'aller au-delà de la théorie de l'IA en participant activement à des missions visant à utiliser l'IA pour résoudre des problèmes.*WHO*•	Les passionnés de technologie qui souhaitent ajouter l'IA à leur palette de compétences •	Les dirigeants ayant des responsabilités financières, opérationnelles ou technologiques qui sont intéressés par l'adoption de l'IA •	Les gestionnaires qui souhaitent mieux soutenir leurs employés techniques en matière d'IA ou qui peuvent être impliqués dans des projets d'IA •	Les employés de différents secteurs qui veulent apprendre comment les solutions d'IA peuvent aider à résoudre des problèmes ou qui veulent contribuer de manière plus significative aux initiatives d'IA de leur organisation. •	Les étudiants qui souhaitent se préparer à travailler dans le domaine de l'IA ou explorer l'IA en tant que carrière potentielle•	Toute personne qui souhaite apprendre les principes fondamentaux de l'IA ou qui est responsable de la sélection et de l'acquisition de systèmes d'IA

list.subject: CEAI
list.title: TRAVAILLER AVEC L'IA
list.description: *VID**KEYB*À quoi ressemble le quotidien d'un professionnel de l'IA ? Dans ce cours, vous ferez l'expérience du flux de travail typique de l'IA en participant à un projet d'IA. De la définition du problème à l'entraînement et à l'évaluation du modèle, vous porterez la casquette d'un scientifique des données et développerez un projet d'apprentissage automatique à l'aide d'un logiciel convivial sans code. Ce processus vous aidera à comprendre les risques et les limites des modèles d'IA et vous apprendra à les atténuer. Enfin, vous découvrirez les applications d'IA les plus récentes et la manière dont elles sont utilisées dans l'industrie. Ce cours met l'accent sur l'apprentissage par l'expérience. Vous apprendrez à utiliser un logiciel sans code, à entraîner un modèle, à améliorer les données d'entraînement grâce à l'ingénierie des caractéristiques et à tester les performances de votre modèle.  Il s'agit d'un cours en ligne, synchrone. Nous recommandons de suivre les cours Fondements de l'IA (CEAI 1001F) et L’IA responsable (CEAI 1002F) avant de suivre ce cours. *CNT*Ce cours est un excellent moyen de vous aider à : •	Manipuler des données dans le cadre d'un projet d'intelligence artificielle •	Communiquer à l'aide de données dans un format visuel facile à comprendre •	Gérer un projet d'IA simple de bout en bout à l'aide d'un logiciel sans code  •	Engager une équipe d'experts pluridisciplinaires pour recueillir des informations sur les questions éthiques•	Explorer les techniques émergentes en matière d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA *APP*Ce cours entièrement en ligne utilise une approche par projets qui se concentre sur l'acquisition de compétences pratiques dans le monde réel en matière d'IA. Vous apprendrez directement auprès de professionnels de l'industrie et recevrez un retour d'information individualisé. Vous aurez l'occasion d'aller au-delà de la théorie de l'IA en participant activement à des missions visant à utiliser l'IA pour résoudre des problèmes.*WHO*•	Les passionnés de technologie qui souhaitent ajouter l'IA à leur palette de compétences•	Les gestionnaires qui souhaitent mieux soutenir leurs employés techniques en IA ou qui peuvent être impliqués dans des projets d'IA •	Les employés de différents secteurs qui veulent apprendre comment les solutions d'IA peuvent aider à résoudre des problèmes ou qui veulent contribuer de manière plus significative aux projets d'IA de leur organisation. •	Les étudiants qui souhaitent se préparer à travailler dans le domaine de l'IA ou explorer l'IA en tant que carrière potentielle •	Toute personne souhaitant commencer à expérimenter l'IA

Our Working with Generative AI course helps you move past quick wins to actually make AI a reliable part of your daily workflow. list.subject: CEBU
list.title: BUSINESS ACUMEN
list.description: *VID**KEYB*One component of job satisfaction is confidence in your ability to execute work responsibilities. But what happens when the responsibilities of your current role or the one you're chasing require fundamental business skills you have yet to formally learn? Designed with you in mind, this course provides insight into each aspect of business operations to complement your current skill set. With newfound confidence, you’ll now be able to participate in strategic discussions and position yourself for greater opportunities in the business world.   *CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Explain the dynamics of a given business including its value chain, the industry in which the business operates, the business' overall strategic positioning and its revenue model•	Evaluate the factors contributing to business success within an industry and the mechanisms through which companies create value and generate profits•	Discuss basic financial concepts such as revenues, margins, fixed and variable costs, overheads, and cash flow •	Explain the core activities and functions that are common across different companies and industries in both demand and supply•	Analyze financial performance using key ratios and manage performance at organizational and business unit level  •	Evaluate the Environmental, Social and Governance implications of business and decision making  *APP*As in the workplace, teamwork is key here. list.title: BUSINESS ACCOUNTING AND FINANCIAL ANALYSIS
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Financial decisions have a tremendous impact on business success. But making these calls requires a specialized skill set, which you'll explore in this accounting and financial management course. Through hands-on exercises and collaborative learning, you'll become familiar with the language, tools, and techniques accounting and finance professionals use on a daily basis. Once you put these skills into practice, you'll be able to analyze financial information and participate in making crucial business decisions.   We recommend taking Business Acumen (CEBU 1150), or equivalent, before taking this course. *CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Demonstrate financial and accounting literacy, including a focus on the accounting cycle, from recording transactions to reporting results•	Compare and Contrast for-profit, non-profit and public accounting•	Interpret financial statements and non-financial information•	Analyze financial performance using key ratios•	Prepare budgets and forecasts for operations•	IInterpret cost behaviours and break-even points for business decisions*APP*As in the workplace, teamwork is key here. In addition to engaging in individual assignments and activities, you can also expect to collaborate with classmates to discuss real-world subjects presented by business experts. In this course, learning will be conducted through a live, online classroom (Zoom).     *WHO*•	Students looking to pursue work in financial domains such as accounting, bookkeeping, and auditing•	New leaders and individual contributors with little to no financial training or exposure •	Managers at all levels, including those in technical and non-financial areas, who are seeking to make better business decisions by understanding financial information•	Foreign business students who want to understand the principles of business accounting in Canada

list.subject: CEBU
list.title: BUSINESS LAW
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Before you sign on the dotted line, you might want to read the contract. And before you do that, you might want to take this course. In it, you'll learn about the general and emerging legal principles that apply to business in Québec and Canada. You'll develop your ability to identify and analyze those legal issues that are pertinent to your day-to-day business transactions and relationships. In short, you'll learn how to stay on the right side of the law. By the way, if you're looking for fine print, you won't find any here.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Identify and produce a binding and enforceable contract;•	Employ the relevant articles of the Civil Code of Québec as they apply to specific business scenarios;•	Determine the most suitable form of business ownership for a new or existing enterprise;•	Develop legally acceptable employment conditions in the workplace.*APP*Your classes will consist of lectures and dynamic discussions on emerging legal topics presented by an experience business lawyer. You'll be strongly encouraged to participate, share your point of view and make your case. This course is designed with a combination of online live synchronous learning where the instructor and the students meet in a virtual classroom (Zoom) at the same time, and asynchronous work guided by the instructor and completed by students in their own time.  *WHO*•	Students who want an introduction to the essentials of business law.•	Students who want to pursue a career or studies in any type of business.•	Budding entrepreneurs who want to understand business law and reduce their liability.•	HR employees and business owners who want to understand the law in the context of the workplace.•	Banking or engineering employees who want to move up through the ranks.•	Young students considering law school and looking for a stepping-stone.•	Anyone who might have to enter into a business contract.•	Anyone who wants to learn more about organizational structures.•	Foreign business students who want to learn the basics of Québec Civil code as it relates to business.

list.subject: CECD

More excitingly, you'll learn through hands-on projects using the  very latest software. This course is designed for the students to meet regularly during live synchronous learning in an online virtual classroom (Zoom).  *WHO*•	Anyone who wants to learn the fundamentals of AutoCAD.•	Students who want to pursue a job in modeling, 3D modeling, 3D printing, any type of engineering, architecture, drafting, manufacturing, designers, draftspersons, machinists and woodworkers, makers, or other related fields. •	Engineering undergraduates and graduate students in Industrial and mechanical specializations.•	CEGEP students who want to prepare for undergraduate degrees and employment.•	Professional and technical staff and engineers who want to update their design techniques and skills.

list.subject: CECD
list.title: SOLIDWORKS I
list.description: *VID**KEYB*If you're interested in 3D and computer-aided design, you obviously have great spatial awareness and a keen desire to get down to work. So, hopefully, people navigate your sites with smiles on their faces.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Create graphic user interfaces •	Optimize graphics for web publication•	Understand and apply user experience design•	Prepare UX designs for websites, tablets, phones, watches and TVs*APP*In this course, you will learn directly from industry professionals who will share the latest industry insights and challenge you with real-world problems. This course is designed for the students to meet regularly during live synchronous learning in an online virtual classroom (Zoom).  *WHO*• Anyone who wants to learn the fundamentals of desktop publishing.• Students who want to work in advertising, animation, graphic design, illustration, printmaking, page layout and digital publication.• Anyone interested in updating their professional portfolio with the latest design trends.• Students looking onward to an academic path in design.• Employees in marketing, communications or sales who want to refresh their skills or are open new horizons.• Small business owners or association members who manage their own communications.• Exhibition designers, fine artists, interior designers, landscape architects, multimedia specialists, photographers and UX designers could also greatly benefit from courses in this program.

list.subject: CEHR
list.title: HUMAN RESOURCES ESSENTIALS
list.description: *VID**KEYB*If you're passionate about developing and uplifting workforce talent, this course is your stepping stone to a fulfilling career in human resources. Explore the critical components of the HR profession, including recruitment, selection, training, performance management, and rewards.   From the initial planning to navigating the legal landscape, we'll guide you through every step of the employment journey. These foundations will help you develop a framework for human resource management (HRM) that you can reply on to further your growth as an effective human resource professional. *CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Plan human resources activities in-line with business objectives and within the context of the organization.•	Discuss the legal framework of Human Resources Management (HRM) in Canada (e.g. employment equity, discrimination, harassment, ethics, etc).•	Assist employees and managers in employee relations. •	Promote employee well-being, health, and safety. •	Apply a structured process to human resource management activities from planning to termination (recruitment, selection, training, performance management, rewards), within the legal framework. *APP*This online synchronous course employs an active learning approach centred on engaging discussions and hands-on learning activities. Through interactive sessions led by HR experts, you will explore real-world challenges and discuss innovative solutions and strategies, drawing insights from other students and professionals working across various industries and company scales. To maximize your learning experience, we encourage you to actively participate in classroom discussions to inspire a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives.  *WHO*•	Human resource professionals or administrative employees with experience working in a small, medium, or large organization.•	HR professionals looking to position themselves for greater leadership roles and advancement in the field. •	Individuals working in the HR field without a formal education in HR who would like to gain formal skills and knowledge. •	Individuals from other domains looking to change careers. •	Employers or employees looking to better understand human resources management. •	Students aspiring to become human resources professionals. •	Anyone looking to experience personal growth through hands-on learning.

list.subject: CEHR
list.title: RECRUITMENT AND SELECTION
list.description: *VID**KEYB*34 people applied for the job but only one will get it. Aside from the obvious factors like experience, what criteria do you use to select the best candidates?    This course addresses that burning question by equipping you with the knowledge and skills to oversee recruitment and selection processes. You'll learn how to locate qualified candidates, analyze internal and external factors that influence hiring, develop strategies for attracting talent, and implement efficient selection methods. With this knowledge, you'll be able to identify and secure the perfect candidates for your organization.  *CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Analyze internal and external factors (e.g.: legal, economic, cultural) that impact the recruitment and selection process of candidates.  •	Perform a job analysis of present and future needs in order to develop job descriptions and job specifications.  •	Develop a recruitment strategy that includes traditional and innovative sourcing techniques to acquire and maintain a diverse candidate pool.  •	Design a selection process to ensure the required qualifications are evaluated and the most appropriate candidate is offered the position.  *APP*This online synchronous program employs an active learning approach centred on engaging discussions and hands-on learning activities. Through interactive sessions led by HR experts, you will explore real-world challenges and discuss innovative solutions and strategies, drawing insights from other students and professionals working across various industries and company scales. To maximize your learning experience, we encourage you to actively participate in classroom discussions to inspire a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives.  *WHO*•	Human resource professionals or administrative employees with experience working in a small, medium, or large organization. •	HR professionals looking to position themselves for greater leadership roles and advancement in the field or become specialists in recruitment and selection. •	Individuals working in the HR field without a formal education in HR who would like to gain formal skills and knowledge in recruitment and selection.•	Individuals from other domains looking to change careers. •	Students who have completed CEHR 1150 and want to continue their studies. •	Students aspiring to become human resources professionals. •	Anyone looking to experience personal growth through hands-on learning.

list.subject: CEHR
list.title: LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT LAW
list.description: *VID**KEYB*This course will introduce you to the principal laws that govern workplaces in Quebec and Canada. You'll learn about the nuances of employment contracts, how to resolve disputes and grievances, and the legal regulations and obligations that shape employer-employee relationships. This knowledge will support you to create a safe and secure non-discriminatory workplace while protecting privacy and ensuring legal compliance. We recommend taking: Human Resources Essentials (CEHR 1150), or equivalent, before taking this course.    *CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Apply the general principles of labour and employment law to everyday human resources practices.•	Analyze important elements covered within offers of employment, employment contracts and termination letters.•	Adapt human resources policies and procedures to comply with Quebec labour and employment law (e.g. employment contracts, hiring, minimum working conditions, termination).•	Use appropriate HR policies and procedures (e.g. workplace safety, psychological harassment, non-discrimination, privacy) to settle disputes and grievances.  •	Consult reliable legal resources and/or lawyers on HR topics (e.g. language laws, unionized workplaces, pay equity).  *APP*This online synchronous course employs an active learning approach centred on engaging discussions and hands-on learning activities. Through interactive sessions led by HR experts, you will explore real-world challenges and discuss innovative solutions and strategies, drawing insights from other students and professionals working across various industries and company scales. To maximize your learning experience, we encourage you to actively participate in classroom discussions to inspire a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives.*WHO*•	Human resource professionals or administrative employees with experience working in a small, medium, or large organization. •	HR professionals looking to position themselves for greater leadership roles and advancement in the field.•	Individuals working in the HR field without a formal education in HR who would like to gain formal skills and knowledge in labour and employment law. •	Individuals from other domains looking to change careers. •	Employers or employees looking to better understand labour and employment law. •	Students who have completed CEHR 1150 and want to continue their studies. •	Students aspiring to become human resources professionals. •	Anyone looking to experience personal growth through hands-on learning.

list.subject: CEHR
list.title: COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Compensation and benefits aren't just perks; they're pivotal drivers of employee satisfaction. In the workplace, HR professionals play a key role in optimizing pay and benefits programs to bolster employee satisfaction, motivation, and retention. In this course, you'll delve into this strategic process by creating a total rewards strategy that aligns with organizational goals. You'll learn how to establish compensation values for various levels of employees, determine direct and indirect pay plans, and design total rewards structures that help attract and engage employees. *CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Formulate a total reward strategy (compensation and benefits) that aligns with organizational goals and strategy. •	Determine compensation values for different categories of employees, compliant with legal requirements and ensuring market competitiveness and internal equity.•	Design a total rewards structure that helps to attract, motivate and engage employees. •	Adapt a total rewards structure taking into consideration the internal and external context. *APP*This online synchronous course employs an active learning approach centred on engaging discussions and hands-on learning activities. Through interactive sessions led by HR experts, you will explore real-world challenges and discuss innovative solutions and strategies, drawing insights from other students and professionals working across various industries and company scales. To maximize your learning experience, we encourage you to actively participate in classroom discussions to inspire a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives.  *WHO*•	Human resource professionals or administrative employees with experience working in a small, medium, or large organization. •	HR professionals looking to position themselves for greater leadership roles and advancement in the field or become specialists in compensation and benefits.•	Individuals working in the HR field without a formal education in HR who would like to gain formal skills and knowledge in compensation and benefits. •	Individuals from other domains looking to change careers. •	Employers or employees looking to better understand compensation and benefits. •	Students who have completed CEHR 1150 and want to continue their studies. •	Students aspiring to become human resources professionals. •	Anyone looking to experience personal growth through hands-on learning.
list.prereq: You must complete all of the following CEHR1150

list.subject: CEHR
list.title: EQUITY, DIVERSITY, AND INCLUSION FOR HR PROFESSIONALS
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI) in the workplace is a growing area of focus for every organization. This course will help you understand the importance of adopting an EDI lens to your HR practice through enhancing the employee experience, organizational culture, innovation, employee engagement and belonging. You will leave with skills that promote self-awareness, and the ability to promote a healthy and inclusive workplace culture.We recommend completing Human Resources Essentials (CEHR 1150) or its equivalent before taking this course.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Evaluate how your identity, lived experiences, and biases, influence your role as an HR professional.  •	Identify ways to incorporate EDI within the employee lifecycle to build a culture of inclusion and belonging. •	Review policies and procedures to incorporate an EDI lens that support goals of inclusion and belonging. •	Use measures to make data-driven decisions that support EDI efforts in the workplace. •	Develop a strong business case for the value of EDI in your organization.  *APP*This online synchronous course employs an active learning approach centred on engaging discussions and hands-on learning activities. Through interactive sessions led by EDI and HR experts, you will explore real-world challenges and discuss innovative solutions and strategies, drawing insights from other students and professionals working across various industries and company scales. To maximize your learning experience, we encourage you to actively participate in classroom discussions to inspire a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives. *WHO*•	Human resource professionals, leaders or administrative employees with experience working in a small, medium, or large organization   •	HR professionals looking to position themselves for greater leadership roles and advancement in the field.  •	Individuals working in the HR field without a formal education in HR who would like to gain formal skills and knowledge. •	Individuals from other domains looking to change careers. •	Employers or employees looking to better understand equity, diversity and inclusion and its importance in HR practice. •	Students who have completed CEHR 1150 and want to continue their studies. •	Students aspiring to become human resources professionals. •	Anyone looking to experience personal growth through hands-on learning.

list.subject: CEHR
list.title: HR DATA ANALYTICS AND TECHNOLOGY
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Technology and data are becoming an increasingly important part of the day-to-day work of HR professionals. These tools are pivotal to improving HR processes and decision-making. In this course, you will learn how to leverage and interpret data and metrics, provide data-based recommendations, and apply data-driven approaches within HR. These skills will allow you to effectively contribute to the digital evolution of HR practices.   We recommend completing Human Resources Essentials (CEHR 1150) or its equivalent before taking this course.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Describe the importance of data and technology in organizations and its relevance to the HR function. •	Evaluate HR technologies based on their functionalities and potential impact on HR processes. •	Identify common HR metrics and how they can be used to make data-driven decisions.  •	Provide actionable recommendations based on HR data to address specific business challenges.•	Communicate data and insights to a non-expert audience. •	Apply change management principles to the implementation of HR technology and analytics. *APP*This online synchronous course employs an active learning approach centred on engaging discussions and hands-on learning activities. Through interactive sessions led by HR experts, you will explore real-world challenges and discuss innovative solutions and strategies, drawing insights from other students and professionals working across various industries and company scales. To maximize your learning experience, we encourage you to actively participate in classroom discussions to inspire a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives. *WHO*•	HR professionals or administrative employees with experience working in a small, medium, or large organization. •	Individuals working in the HR field without a formal education in HR who would like to gain formal skills and knowledge. •	Students who are aspiring to become HR professionals. •	HR professionals looking to position themselves for greater leadership roles and advancement in the field. •	Students or HR professionals seeking an introduction into HR technology and analytics.  •	Individuals seeking a hands-on learning experience and practical knowledge in HR technology and analytics. •	Employers or employees looking to better understand how to incorporate HR technology and data into their workplace.

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: EDITING SKILLS FOR CLEAR WRITING
list.description: *VID**KEYB*The difference between good and great writing is in the edit. Without that crucial step, your writing can’t reach its full potential. Editing Skills for Clear Writing helps writers adopt a thoughtful process for polishing any piece of writing. Through hands-on exercises focused on grammar, syntax, and style, you’ll learn how to improve clarity, accuracy, and flow. With insight into how professional editors approach editing, you’ll gain the skills to polish your own work without needing a separate set of eyes.*CNT*•	Understand the role of an editor and what to look for when editing •	Improve clarity and flow through stronger sentence and paragraph structure •	Apply correct spelling, punctuation, and fact-checking in your editing •	Recognize and correct common writing issues such as wordiness and redundancy  •	Edit your work and the work of others with accuracy and confidence•	Strengthen tone, style, and voice through precise editing choices  •	Understand how to meet professional deadlines while polishing writing *APP*Through guided practice and collaborative exercises, you’ll apply editing techniques across various formats and styles. This process-focused approach builds precision and shows you how thoughtful revision improves writing.   *WHO*•	Writers who want to polish their work with stronger editing skills •	Professionals who write or edit as part of their job•	Communications specialists, journalists, bloggers or podcasters looking to sharpen their writing•	Professionals looking to pursue a career in writing, publishing, or content creation•	Learners who want to bring greater clarity, accuracy, and style to their writing

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: INTRO TO CREATIVE WRITING
list.description: *VID**KEYB*The hardest part of writing is knowing where to start. Without a little direction and practice, the motivation to keep going can quickly fade. Intro to Creative Writing shows you how to take the first step through guided practice in fiction and creative non-fiction. You’ll explore how elements like point-of-view, character, dialogue, and structure intertwine to bring stories to life. Each week, you’ll write, share, and reflect on your work in a supportive setting designed to help your writing grow and make writing something you look forward to. *CNT*•	Develop a personal writing routine that builds consistency•	Apply core literary techniques such as character, dialogue, structure, and pacing •	Identify revision strategies to refine your work•	Critique your own work and offer constructive feedback to peers   •	Complete a short-form story or project that showcases your improved writing*APP*Through interactive exercises and group discussions, you’ll put the fundamentals of writing into practice. This hands-on approach encourages experimentation and helps you build writing consistency. *WHO*•	New writers seeking structure and support to begin a project•	Lapsed writers looking to get back into the craft with refreshed skills•	Professionals wanting to understand fiction and creative non-fiction story structure •	Writers seeking regular feedback and consistent practice •	Writers eager to join a supportive and productive writing community

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: WRITING FOR CHILDREN
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Every word matters when you write for young readers. On every page, you need to spark their imagination and keep their curiosity alive. Writing for Children helps you bring imaginative ideas to life and connect with younger audiences. You’ll explore how characters, voice, and theme combine to create stories that stick with readers long after the final page. Through regular writing, feedback, and discussion, you’ll experiment with formats like board books, picture books, and chapter books and finish with a polished piece that captures the wonder of children. *CNT*•	Develop storytelling skills for children of all ages and reading levels •	Explore the creative and design process behind children’s books •	Recognize the range and diversity of content in children’s publishing •	Create a complete children’s book•	Identify best practices for navigating the children’s publishing industry •	Become comfortable sharing and writing in a group setting*APP*Through interactive workshops and expert guidance, you’ll experiment with voice, structure, and imagination for young readers. This playful, hands-on approach encourages curiosity and refinement so you can bring stories to life with authenticity and joy.  *WHO*•	Writers interested in creating stories for children of any age •	Writers curious about the craft and structure of children’s literature•	Educators or storytellers who want to share ideas with younger audiences•	Parents, grandparents, or relatives wanting to write stories for the children in their lives •	Writers eager to join a supportive and productive writing community

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: WRITING A NOVELLA
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Long-form fiction can feel challenging to balance. With so many moving parts — characters, scenes, and plot — it’s easy for doubt to creep in and disrupt your creative process before you reach the finish line. Writing a Novella guides you through developing long-form fiction from concept to early drafts. You’ll learn how to steer narrative arcs, develop characters, and refine dialogue while building the discipline to keep writing consistently. Each week, you’ll engage in practical assignments, class discussions, and peer review sessions to generate momentum toward your completed story. *CNT*•	Apply techniques for creating and sustaining character, plot, and pacing •	Develop several excerpts from an original novella or novel •	Evaluate your own work and provide constructive feedback on the work of your peers •	Build focus and consistency to support long-form writing goals •	Identify best practices for navigating traditional and independent publishing *APP*Through step-by-step guidance and group discussion, you’ll practice long-form writing in a hands-on way. This approach encourages experimentation and reflection so you can sustain momentum and direct your story with purpose.  *WHO*•	Writers excited about pursuing a long-form writing project•	Writers seeking to better understand how to structure and sustain a long-form story•	Writers eager to join a supportive and productive writing community

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: CREATIVE NON-FICTION
list.description: *VID**KEYB*When true stories are told well, they can feel as vivid as fiction. But balancing the truth with storytelling is one of the toughest skills for writers to master. Creative Non-Fiction helps you turn lived experience, observation, and research into unforgettable narratives. You’ll explore forms such as personal essays, travel narratives, and reportage while learning how to structure scenes, develop real people as characters, and build tension using storytelling techniques. Through guided writing, feedback, and discussion, you’ll weave facts and narratives to make real events come to life on the page. *CNT*•	Describe the major forms of creative non-fiction, including personal essays and reportage •	Conduct research to identify key story elements such as setting, character, plot, and facts •	Complete several pieces of non-fiction writing ready for submission or for your personal goals•	Learn strategies for revision, pitching, and preparing work for publication•	Build focus, discipline, and creative confidence through consistent practice*APP*Through guided writing, peer feedback, and practical exercises, you’ll learn how to make real stories feel vivid. This hands-on approach builds confidence, precision, and creative range so you can craft non-fiction that informs and engages readers.  *WHO*•	Writers looking to apply creative writing techniques to make true stories feel as vivid as fiction•	Writers interested in essays, journalism, biography, or other forms of literary non-fiction •	Fiction writers curious about non-fiction techniques•	Editorial writers, bloggers, or podcasters seeking new techniques to tell real stories.•	Writers eager to join a supportive and productive writing community

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: TRAVEL WRITING
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Chances are you've traveled to some fascinating places, near or far. Maybe you even traveled here from abroad to study. Or then again, it could be you're simply fascinated with the idea of exploring someplace new. Wouldn't you love to tell your story; to capture your readers' attention and take them on a journey of your own? If that sounds exciting, you've arrived at your destination. This course will help you do all that and more through workshops and short travel-writing assignments as well as feature-length, first-person travelogues. You'll see: once you've honed your skills as a travel writer, your readers will follow you to the end of the earth.*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Research a potential travel story with a specific angle;•	Gain understanding of how to work with travel/media professionals;•	Market yourself successfully as a travel writer;•	Pitch your idea to an editor and complete the assignment.*APP*This is a writing class, so you'll be doing a lot of it. You'll also learn through interactive workshops, exercises, group discussions, and assignments. Enthusiastic participation and effort are the keys to enjoyment and success in this course. This course is designed for the students to meet regularly during live synchronous learning in an online virtual classroom (Zoom).  *WHO*•	Anyone who wants to improve their writing skills.•	Anyone considering a career as a writer.•	Anyone considering a career in journalism.•	Fiction writers who want to learn how to write in a new format.•	Travelers who want to learn how to tell the stories of their journeys.•	Advertising copywriters who want to branch out into other forms of writing.•	Foreign students who want to improve their written English.•	Retirees or busy executives who want to try something new to balance out their lives.

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: WRITING YOUR MEMOIR
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Everyone has a few pivotal stories they’d love for the world to read. But turning personal anecdotes into a narrative that resonates with others isn’t easy. Writing Your Memoir shows you how to adapt your lived experiences into a compelling story. You’ll explore how to find the right angle, create vivid scenes, and uncover the themes present in your defining moments. Through guided support, discussion, and feedback, you’ll refine crucial story elements — such as character, setting, and dialogue — to bring cohesion to your memoir and make your experiences resonate with others. *CNT*•	Develop a focused and compelling personal narrative •	Apply storytelling techniques such as tension, scene, and sensory detail•	Create authentic characters, settings, and dialogue drawn from your life•	Implement revision and self-editing techniques to refine your work•	Identify best practices for navigating non-fiction publishing *APP*Through guided exercises and collaborative feedback, you’ll work toward transforming your personal experiences into a cohesive story. This hands-on approach encourages experimentation and reflection, bringing you closer to realizing your memoir.  *WHO*•	Writers excited about pursuing a writing project about their life •	Writers curious about exploring non-fiction •	Writers looking to capture stories for family, community, or publication •	Writers eager to join a supportive and productive writing community

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: SCREENWRITING WORKSHOP: GETTING STARTED
list.description: *VID**KEYB*The thought of a completed screenplay is exciting, but getting started can feel overwhelming. In this course, you’ll focus on each essential element to simplify the process. You’ll explore characters, conflict, dialogue, and structure, and learn how to weave them together to begin creating a narrative. In an uplifting writers’ room setting, you’ll workshop your idea with peers and your instructor, develop a polished first act of a screenplay, and gain the confidence to keep writing.*CNT*•	Understand story structure and the essentials of screenwriting •	Identify the core elements of a script, such as characters and dialogue •	Build a clear rollout for your script from beginning to resolution•	Practice writing and critiquing scripts in a workshop setting •	Understand how to pitch and present your work•	Write a complete act of a larger script *APP*Learning is built on practice and collaboration. You will write continuously, participate in workshops, and receive feedback from instructors and peers. Active participation is key to completing your script and gaining the confidence to continue writing beyond the program.  *WHO*Writers who:•	Want to develop a feature-length script or short screenplay •	Want structured guidance and feedback to get their project started•	Are looking to understand how to develop characters, conflict, and story structure•	Are eager to join a supportive and productive writing community

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: INTRO TO BLOGGING
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Let's be clear, just because you can say anything you like on Facebook doesn't mean you should. The same goes for blogging. There's a lot more to it than just posting whatever comes to mind. And this course will prove that point. If you want to demystify the world of blogging, start a blog, build a network and/or improve the quality of your blog, this is the course for you. You'll examine how blogging differs from traditional writing. You'll learn how to identify a potential audience and choose the right words to generate traffic, hits and advertising to your site. You'll also develop your own personal or professional blog and publish a series of posts to practice the fundamentals of writing for the web. Limber up your fingers and your mind; it's blogging time!*CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Identify and discuss approaches to online vs. print writing; •	Learn how to build an audience; •	Employ writing techniques and approaches for blogging;•	Explore a variety of writing techniques for social media posts;•	Create your own blog;•	Learn how to generate hits and advertising to your blog;•	Manage and adhere to deadlines.*APP*This course is all about writing, so you'll be doing a lot of it. You'll also learn through interactive workshops, exercises, group discussions and assignments. Enthusiastic participation and effort are the keys to enjoyment and success in this program. This course is designed for the students to meet regularly during live synchronous learning in an online virtual classroom (Zoom).  *WHO*•	Anyone who wants to develop their creativity.•	Anyone who wants to use blogging to build a network.•	Anyone who wants to learn how to write social media posts and blogs for personal or business reasons.•	Copywriters who want to broaden their professional horizons.•	People who are interested in learning a new genre of writing. •	Professionals who want to share their work, ideas and research with an on-line community.•	Anyone who wants to generate more traffic to their websites.

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: SCREENWRITING WORKSHOP: STORY DEVELOPMENT
list.description: *VID**KEYB*It’s one thing to start a script and another to carry it through with momentum, cohesion, and resolution. In this course, you’ll build on the draft you began in Screenwriting Workshop: Getting Started, learning how to edit and refine story structure, make characters more dynamic, and bring your plot to completion. In a writers’ room-style workshop setting, you’ll give and receive peer feedback that advances your story and trains you to confidently pitch a completed screenplay with clarity and impact. *CNT*•	Develop your concept into a fleshed-out screenplay by expanding story beats and plot points •	Edit and critique your own work and that of your peers in a writers’ room •	Complete a 30-minute screenplay that meets studio standards •	Create supporting pitch materials such as character breakdowns, treatments and pitch decks•	Apply industry techniques to confidently market your screenplay  *APP*Learning is built on practice and collaboration. You will write continuously, participate in workshops, and receive feedback from instructors and peers. Active participation is key to completing your script and gaining the confidence to continue writing beyond the program. *WHO*Writers who:•	Are actively developing a feature-length script and seeking structured feedback•	Want encouragement and a supportive writing community to finish their script •	Aim to strengthen storytelling, dialogue, structure, and formatting through peer-edited workshopping
list.prereq: You must first complete CEJN 136

list.subject: CEJN
list.title: WRITERS’ WORKSHOP: REFINING YOUR MANUSCRIPT
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Manuscript projects often stall without structure, feedback, and guidance. This course helps you develop your skills in a supportive environment that keeps you focused and motivated to push your piece forward. By practicing a variety of essential writing techniques and sharing excerpts for critique, you’ll strengthen your voice, pacing, and creative self-awareness to complete your polished manuscript.*CNT*•	Apply literary techniques to develop a stronger narrative voice, pacing, style, and conflict •	Edit and critique your own work and that of your peers•	Implement focusing and motivation strategies to meet project deadlines •	Complete a manuscript (or excerpts) that integrate feedback and literary techniques •	Understand and apply best practices to navigate the publishing market*APP*Learning is built on practice and collaboration. You will write continuously, participate in workshops, and receive feedback from instructors and peers. Active participation is key to completing your manuscript and gaining the confidence to continue writing beyond the program. *WHO*Writers who:•	Are actively developing an ongoing manuscript in any genre•	Want structured, constructive feedback from peers and instructors •	Seek guidance and motivation to sustain a longer project•	Are committed to refining their craft through regular practice and peer review •	Are eager to join a supportive and productive writing communit

list.subject: CELD
list.title: Refining Management Reflexes
list.description: *VID**KEYB*What’s the difference between leadership and management? Not quite sure? Don’t worry, when you’ve finished this course, you’ll have a great grasp of both. Here, you’ll learn the art of influencing your team members as well as directing them through effective planning, organization and control. You’ll learn best practices for creating a high performing team built on diversity and inclusivity. You’ll gain experience delegating effectively, managing small projects and assessing personal and organizational time-management practices. With this course and a little hard work on your part, the skills you need to become a better leader and manager will soon become second nature. *CNT*This course is a great way to help you:•	Learn to manage teams built on diversity and inclusivity to create better synergy;•	Practise managing small projects effectively;•	Delegate tasks and responsibilities effectively using an approach which encourages collaboration;•	Foster a collaborative workplace;•	Work towards creating team synergy in diverse work environments and teams;•	Manage time and priorities efficiently. *APP*Students will engage in practical and critical thinking courses allowing them to reflect and project themselves in their current or future work environment. list.subject: CEPR
list.title: EFFECTIVE PUBLIC SPEAKING
list.description: *VID**KEYB*Public speaking is one of the biggest sources of workplace anxiety. The pressure of the moment can make even the strongest ideas hard to express, leading to missed opportunities for advancement, lost confidence, and the frustration of not being fully understood. Our Effective Public Speaking course helps you speak in a way that makes people listen and remember your message. Through storytelling and presentation techniques, you’ll find your authentic voice so you can deliver your ideas naturally in presentations, meetings, or pitches. This course includes in-person and live online classes. Note: This course focuses on developing public speaking skills rather than language learning. To get the most from it, participants should already feel comfortable communicating in English.*CNT*•	Understand how to use storytelling to make presentations engaging and memorable•	Structure your ideas and presentations clearly to inform, persuade, and connect with any audience•	Adapt your delivery to different settings including meetings, pitches, and large presentations•	Practice mindful body language, voice, and pacing to make your message land *APP*This course provides you with a unique opportunity to practice your public speaking in a supportive environment without fear of judgement. list.description: *VID**KEYB*Data is the new gold mine. The more people interact with each other, be it through Facebook and Twitter, or platforms like Amazon, the more data is generated, collected and exploited. Unlike gold, the regulations around data are much more obscure. Does the data generated belong to those who produce them, or those who collect them? What about the ethics of using these data for commercial purposes? Some of these questions regarding the legal and ethical aspect of utilizing data have emerged given the significant commercialization of data in recent years. Another angle of AI research and commercialization that must be seriously considered is the ethical use of data. Companies that spearhead AI development, such as Google and Microsoft, recognize the importance of these implications and have incorporated new ethics roles into their organizations. As Montreal is an international leader of Ethical AI initiatives and development of talent, it is more important now than ever for industry professionals to be aware of international legal regulations, ethical aspects of AI, and data privacy associated with both public and private, current and future data-related initiatives. *CNT*This training will enable you to:• Analyze international data protection laws in the US, Canada, Europe and China;• Evaluate and analyze the role of ethical and legal implications associated with the boom of international AI initiatives and the development of ethical principles in AI;• Understand the importance of evaluating ethical and legal impact as a result of AI technologies when developing an AI-oriented business strategy;• Discuss existing industry cases such as Facebook, Cambridge Analytica, Amazon, etc.*APP*This business-oriented workshop is based on fundamental theories and industry case studies taken from large data-driven companies. In short, you’ll learn by reading, analyzing, and discussing. list.subject: CEPS
list.title: Introduction to Drone Videography
list.description:
*VID**KEYB*This workshop is offered in English.Drone videography has really taken off the past few years, enabling breathtaking footage rarely available in the past. And if you’re like many people, you dream of being behind the controls, piloting your drone into new career horizons. It thrills us, too. Which is why we created this introductory workshop. Led by award-winning videographer Diego Rivera-Kohn, you’ll learn about the laws that regulate drone flight in Canada and the basic operation of the more common consumer drones that don’t require a pilot’s certificate. You’ll also learn foundational themes like shot height, speed, distance and gimbal, and the narrative potential they have. Basic camera techniques will focus on light, composition, movement, depth, and suspense. And finally, you’ll have the chance to apply all that knowledge and skill as you learn how to film landscapes, architecture, and people. Ready to take flight?La vidéographie par drone est en plein essor depuis quelques années, permettant la captation d’images à couper le souffle qu’il était rarement possible de réaliser dans le passé. Comme beaucoup d’enthousiastes, vous rêvez certainement de prendre les commandes de votre drone – jusqu’à en faire une nouvelle carrière! Voilà une perspective très emballante en effet. Et c’est ce qui nous a incités à offrir cet atelier. Sous l’encadrement du vidéographe primé Diego Rivera Kohn, vous vous initierez aux lois qui régissent l’utilisation d’un drone au Canada de même qu’au fonctionnement de base des drones grand public les plus courants dont le pilotage n’exige pas de certificat de pilote. Vous explorerez des thèmes fondamentaux comme l’altitude de prise de vue, la vitesse et la suspension à cardan ainsi que leur potentiel sur le plan narratif. L’apprentissage des techniques de caméra fondamentales sera axé sur la lumière, la composition, le mouvement, la profondeur et la tension dramatique. Enfin, vous aurez l’occasion d’appliquer toutes ces nouvelles connaissances et habiletés en apprenant à filmer des paysages, des œuvres architecturales et des gens. Attention, décollage!*CNT*This workshop will empower you to:• Understand safety, ethical and legal aspects of operating drones;• Safely operate drones (under 249 grams) for audiovisual content acquisition;• Understand the role of storytelling in drone videography;• Apply basic techniques in drone videography to produce quality audiovisual content that has impact;• Build marketable, professional drone videography skills.À la fin de cet atelier, vous :• comprendrez les aspects sécuritaires, éthiques et juridiques de l’utilisation des drones;• saurez faire fonctionner des drones (de moins de 249 grammes) en toute sécurité à des fins d’acquisition de contenu audiovisuel;• comprendrez le rôle du récit dans la vidéographie par drone;• saurez appliquer des techniques de base de vidéographie par drone pour produire du contenu audiovisuel percutant et de qualité;• acquerrez des compétences professionnelles commercialisables en vidéographie par drone.*APP*This is a five-class, 15-hour workshop, with each class lasting three hours. Nine hours will take place in the classroom, six hours will take place outdoors, as per the following schedule:Week 1) Friday, May 24, 13:00 – 16:00 – in-class at the Mel Hoppenheim School of CinemaWeek 2) Friday, May 31, 13:00 – 16:00 – outdoors at the de Maisonneuve Field, Loyola campus, (weather permitting )Week 3) Friday, June 7, 13:00 – 16:00 – in-class at the Mel Hoppenheim School of Cinema Week 4) Friday, June 14, 13:00 – 16:00 – outdoors (location tbd)Week 5) Friday, June 21, 13:00 – 16 :00 – in class at the Mel Hoppenheim School of CinemaCet atelier d’une durée totale de 15 heures se compose de cinq cours de trois heures chacun. Neuf heures de cours ont lieu en classe, et six heures, à l’extérieur, selon l’horaire suivant :1re semaine : vendredi 24 mai 2024, 13 h – 16 h; en classe, à l’École de cinéma MelHoppenheim2e semaine : vendredi 31 mai 2024, 13 h – 16 h; à l’extérieur, sur le terrain De Maisonneuve, situé sur le campus Loyola, si la météo le permet 3e semaine : vendredi 7 juin 2024, 13 h – 16 h; en classe, à l’École de cinéma Mel-Hoppenheim, 4e semaine : vendredi 14 juin 2024, 13 h – 16 h; à l’extérieur 5e semaine : vendredi 21 juin 2024, 13h – 16 h; en classe, à l’École de cinéma Mel-Hoppenheim*WHO*• Videographers who want to broaden their artistic horizons.• Photographers who want to create compelling video footage.• Anyone interested in creating professional-quality drone footage for personal use.• Les vidéographes qui souhaitent élargir leurs horizons artistiques.• Les photographes qui souhaitent créer des images vidéo captivantes.• Toute personne qui s’intéresse à la création d’images vidéo par drone de qualité professionnelle à des fins d’utilisation personnelle.*ADD*1) Drones and SD cards will be provided by Concordia University; personal drones are not permitted. Students must have access to a computer or laptop to download images and videos outside of class time.2) In the event we don’t have enough participants, the workshop will be cancelled and you will, of course, be reimbursed in full.3) This workshop meets the requirements for the 1% Conformity Law (in accordance with the Workforce Skills Development and Recognition Act).4) If you wish to pay for this workshop via invoice, please write directly to cce@concordia.ca and our service staff will assist you.1) Les drones et les cartes mémoire SD sont fournis par l’Université Concordia; les drones personnels sont interdits. Les personnes étudiantes doivent avoir accès à un ordinateur ou à un portable pour télécharger les images et les enregistrements vidéo à l’extérieur des heures de cours.2) Si le nombre d’inscriptions est insuffisant, l’atelier sera annulé et les personnes inscrites seront remboursées intégralement.3) Cet atelier répond aux exigences de la « loi du 1 % » (Loi favorisant le développement et la reconnaissance des compétences de la main-d’œuvre).4) Si vous souhaitez payer pour cet atelier par règlement de facture, veuillez écrire directement à Formation continue Concordia à l’adresse cce@concordia.ca. Notre personnel se fera un plaisir de vous aider.*TR*[IMAGE_C:/content/dam/cce/images/trainers/Diego_Rivera_Kohn.jpg|Diego Rivera Kohn]Diego Rivera Kohn
With an MFA (Film Production) from Concordia University, Diego is also the Coordinator of the university’s Digital Animation program. While oxygen, food, water, and love sustain him, it is the act of creating that makes him feel most fully human. And that creativity most often finds expression in the act of visual storytelling. In addition to his drone skills, Diego designs and produces motion images for cinema and for multimedia. His films have screened at prominent festivals in Europe, Asia, and North and South America. One of his most recent films, Ex-voto for Three Souls, won a Golden Frog Award at the Plus Camerimage Festival (2008), the world’s premiere film festival dedicated to the art of cinematography. A drone pilot licensed by Transport Canada, Diego is thrilled to be leading this workshop to help train the next generation of drone videographers.Diego Rivera Kohn
Titulaire d’une maîtrise ès beaux-arts en production cinématographique de l’Université Concordia, Diego Rivera Kohn est coordonnateur du programme d’animation de synthèse. Bien qu’il compte sur l’oxygène, la nourriture, l’eau et l’amour pour assurer sa survie, c’est dans l’acte de créer qu’il se sent en pleine possession de son humanité. Or, sa créativité trouve le plus souvent son expression dans le récit visuel. Outre ses compétences dans le maniement des drones, Diego Rivera Kohn conçoit et produit des images en mouvement pour le cinéma et le multimédia. Ses films ont été projetés dans de nombreux festivals importants en Amérique du Nord, en Amérique du Sud, en Asie et en Europe. L’une de ses plus récentes œuvres, Ex-voto for Three Souls, a obtenu la Grenouille d’or au Festival Plus Camerimage (2008) – événement de renommée internationale consacré à l’art cinématographique. Titulaire d’un certificat de pilote de drone de Transport Canada, Diego Rivera Kohn est très enthousiaste à l’idée de diriger cet atelier et de soutenir la prochaine génération de vidéastes par drone.
